note: The five preview captions per fighter (the fighters' voice bibles, docs/narrative/voices/; original, unsearched lines), with the mood and intensity a dialogue director would attach. Used by tools/render_babble.gd and babble_check.gd.

protagonist.text: Good. You came. Now show me everything.
Ha! My arm. I'll need that later.
That was somebody's roof. I'll help rebuild it once I'm done here.
Hold on, hold on. I'll be fine in a minute.
Say that about them once more. Just once.

anti_hero.text: You were adequate. That is the highest thing I say.
I can't feel my arms. Help me.

empress.text: You struck us! Do you know what revision this is? ...You struck ME.
Annexing. The empire thanks you for your patronage.
This is an unapproved outcome! We appeal. ...I APPEAL.
Revision Four. We have added a hat.

cyborg.text: Your order has been fulfilled. Please rate your experience.
Not the chip! Anything but the chip!
I would like to speak to a manager. Is there a manager?
N-n-not the chip. Not the... not the chip.
